game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream, a stream of spirits: the druid must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream: a stream of spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Stream, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round, thorn goblins strike the vine bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stones value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the vine bridge from thorn goblins in Spirit Stream: keep the stones meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: stones drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Spirit Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Spirit Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while stones > 0.
